thread.title: Apple Stock Up As Biggest iPhone Launch In Four Years Seen

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Up As Biggest iPhone Launch In Four Years Seen
text:
Apple stock rose Tuesday as the tech giant prepares to ship 70 million to 75 million units of its 12th-generation iPhone models by the end of the year, industry sources told DigiTimes. That would be Apple 's ( AAPL ) biggest launch since the iPhone 6 series in late 2014, the Taiwan-based newspaper said Tuesday.
X Apple is widely expected to introduce three new iPhone models at a media event in early to mid-September. Analysts believe the Cupertino, Calif.-based company will debut an updated 5.8-inch OLED-screen smartphone, a plus-size 6.5-inch OLED model and a 6.1-inch LCD-screen handset.
The initial iPhone orders could drive fourth-quarter revenue to new highs for Apple contract manufacturers including Foxconn and chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ), DigiTimes reported .
Apple stock rose 0.8% to 219.70 on the stock market today . Earlier in the session, it hit an all-time high of 220.54.

Three New iPhone Models Coming Apple's new smartphones will mirror the design of the iPhone X and have edge-to-edge displays, Bloomberg reported Monday . The OLED model handsets will feature faster processors and better cameras, it said.
All three phones will have Face ID facial-recognition technology as a security feature, Bloomberg said. That feature today is only available on the flagship iPhone X model. Users can open their phones with a glance or complete purchases using Apple Pay with the technology.
In addition to new iPhones, Apple is likely to unveil its fourth-generation Apple Watch smartwatches at the media event, analysts say. Those new smartwatches will sport slightly larger displays and enhanced heart-rate detection, they say.
Apple is rumored to be ditching its 3D Touch technology from all of its new iPhones, MacRumors reported Monday. The consumer electronics giant introduced the pressure-sensitive touch-screen technology in 2015 with the iPhone 6S.
